column1: # Form names by National Dex number and form, as Gen 7 numbers forms. source: sun_moon, the Sun
# and Moon carts' form list (member 114), whose line for a species names its first form and
# whose lines past the last species name the other forms in species order (the personal
# table's form counts, a/0/1/7, place them); pokeapi, the forms only Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon
# have, from PokeAPI (421247a969939f793c52bf8105f3c4e35517d8c1); omega_ruby_alpha_sapphire, the Pikachu forms those
# games number their own way, from their form list (member 5 of a/0/7/1 to a/0/7/8), which has
# no Chinese. Forms the lists leave unnamed, such as totems, are left out. Unown's forms are
# "One form" and Arceus's and Genesect's their species' name, as the carts write them.
